summary.text: Roger F. Wicker has represented Mississippi in the U.S. Senate since December 2007 and chairs the Senate Armed Services Committee in the 119th Congress.

paragraphs.text: He was elected seven times from 1994 to Mississippi's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House, and earlier served in the state Senate for Lee and Pontotoc counties.
A native of Pontotoc, he holds B.A. and law degrees from the University of Mississippi and retired from the Air Force Reserve in 2004 as a lieutenant colonel.
